manifestEntries.threadTitle: Build a portfolio someone can verify
manifestEntries.alt: Make your work inspectable. Portfolio structure. An ordered teaching sequence. Problem; What needed to change?; Your contribution; Mark the part you owned.; Evidence; Link an artifact a reviewer can inspect. Give the reviewer a path from your claim to your work.

manifestEntries.threadTitle: Build a portfolio someone can verify
manifestEntries.alt: Show the failure case. Teaching example: withdrawal tests. Side-by-side comparison. Allowed caller; Transfer succeeds; Check the expected result; Rejected caller; Caller lacks permission; Check the rejection. Include setup steps, the test command and known limits.

manifestEntries.threadTitle: Build a portfolio someone can verify
manifestEntries.alt: Connect content to an action. Proposed wallet-tutorial funnel. An ordered teaching sequence. Tutorial reader; Audience for the guide; Setup attempt; User starts the task; Setup completion; User reaches the intended action. Record measurement limits. Impressions do not show setup completion.

manifestEntries.threadTitle: Build a portfolio someone can verify
manifestEntries.alt: Document a repeatable task. Sample support runbook. Paired rows link each subject to its action or condition. User; Sends an error report; Moderator; Assigns an owner and next update; Engineer; Investigates and records the resolution. Make the next handoff explicit.

manifestEntries.threadTitle: Build a portfolio someone can verify
manifestEntries.alt: Label the evidence honestly. Three evidence formats. Side-by-side comparison. Public work; Link the artifact; Name your contribution; Approved redaction; Explain the constraint; Show permitted material; Personal exercise; Label it as practice; Describe your decisions. Use the evidence status that matches the work.

manifestEntries.threadTitle: Build a portfolio someone can verify
manifestEntries.alt: Run the reviewer check. Before applying. A reusable checklist with empty checkboxes. Evidence link; Open it while logged out.; Relevant sample first; Make the role match visible.; Authorship clear; Name your contribution.; Limits stated; Explain one limitation. The reviewer should not need to request access.

Read the permission you are granting. ERC-20 approval. Educational relationship diagram. Token holder; Account granting permission; Approved spender; Address receiving permission; Token contract; Records the allowance for this token and spender on this network. Check token, spender, amount and network before approving.

Compare the trade and the cap. Hypothetical token-quantity example. Two proportional bars: the 200-token cap is ten times the 20-token trade. Planned trade; 20 tokens; Requested cap; 200; Review the difference.; Where supported, set a cap for the intended use. The requested allowance is larger than the planned trade.

Disconnecting and revoking differ. Two separate states. Side-by-side comparison. Disconnect website; Changes the site connection; Onchain allowance remains; Revoke allowance; Submit on the relevant network; Check confirmation; fee normally applies. Only the revocation changes the spending permission.

A signature can carry spending authority. ERC-2612 permit. An ordered teaching sequence. Read the permit; Spender, amount and submission deadline; Sign the approval; No gas paid at this signing step; Later onchain submission; Someone can submit the signed permit. The deadline limits submission, not the resulting allowance lifetime.

Check the NFT permission scope. NFT operator permissions. One highlighted NFT is contrasted with all NFTs in the same collection contract. One-item approval; A; B; C; One approved NFT; Collection-wide; A; B; C; Every NFT you own from this collection contract; Check the named operator. Collection-wide means one collection contract, not every NFT in a wallet.

Keep an allowance review record. Allowance review inventory. A worksheet with explicitly labeled blank personal fields. Account and network; [scope to review]; Spender; [approved spender]; Remaining allowance; [current permission]; Revocation receipt; [confirmed transaction]. Revocation cannot reverse a transfer or repair an exposed private key.

manifestEntries.threadTitle: Compare cities against a real workweek
manifestEntries.alt: Start with the workweek. Hypothetical work patterns. Side-by-side comparison. Recruiter; Private calls; Scheduled team overlap; Async engineer; Long focus blocks; Routine that fits the team. Write the conditions your own workweek needs.

manifestEntries.threadTitle: Compare cities against a real workweek
manifestEntries.alt: Separate requirements from preferences. Sample decision matrix, no city scores. Side-by-side comparison. Requirements; Private call space: [check]; Team overlap: [check]; Preferences; Walkability: [check]; Warm weather: [check]. A high overall score cannot replace a missing requirement.

manifestEntries.threadTitle: Compare cities against a real workweek
manifestEntries.alt: Change the comparison question. City directory: actual controls. Genuine product control crops, arranged separately for reading. Question: living costs; Question: internet; Compare your selections; Other categories; Safety, walkability and weather. Separate control states. Costs, rankings and counts are excluded. Crops show ranking selector set to Living costs; ranking selector set to Internet speed; Compare control.

manifestEntries.threadTitle: Compare cities against a real workweek
manifestEntries.alt: Check the actual room. From city research to room checks. Nested city, neighborhood and room scopes lead to checks of the actual accommodation. City-level research; Neighborhood; Actual room; Desk + call privacy + connection + host confirmation. Ask the host about the actual accommodation.

manifestEntries.threadTitle: Compare cities against a real workweek
manifestEntries.alt: Use the dates you would stay. Undated stay-planning diagram. A branching relationship diagram. Your intended stay dates; Weather by month; Compare the months you will be there.; Team meeting dates; Map calls to your local work hours. Check the daily routine as well as the city.

manifestEntries.threadTitle: Compare cities against a real workweek
manifestEntries.alt: Keep the unknowns beside the shortlist. Blank city shortlist. A worksheet with explicitly labeled blank personal fields. City; [your option]; Host question; [quote or room detail]; Employer question; [work arrangement]; Entry check; [official source to verify]. Keep unanswered questions beside each option.
